title: Why Your House Isn't Actually an Asset

beats.say: Your home isn't an asset. Robert Kiyosaki wrote in Rich Dad Poor Dad that it's actually a liability.
beats.visual: A cinematic shot of a suburban house exterior at dusk, viewed from behind a dark iron fence.

beats.say: Here's why. An asset puts money in your pocket. A liability takes money out.
beats.visual: A hand sliding a monthly mortgage statement across a dark wooden kitchen table.

beats.say: Your house takes cash every single month for mortgage, taxes, and repairs. It doesn't pay you.
beats.visual: Close-up of a fountain pen signing a check on a blurred kitchen counter.

beats.say: Most people stay stuck in the rat race because they buy a bigger house as soon as they get a raise.
beats.visual: A lone silhouette walking down a long, narrow concrete office hallway under dim lights.

beats.say: Expenses rise right along with income. You're forced to keep working just to pay the bills.
beats.visual: A calculator sitting next to a stack of unopened mail on a dimly lit desk.

beats.say: Kiyosaki says true wealth comes from buying things that generate cash flow without your labor.
beats.visual: An overhead shot of brass keys resting on a clean, dark marble surface.

beats.say: But here's the honest catch. Real estate takes heavy capital, and Kiyosaki's own company once filed for bankruptcy.
beats.visual: A person's hands holding a set of blueprints, blurred and viewed from a high angle.

beats.say: Leverage cuts both ways. Debt can break you just as fast as it builds you.
beats.visual: A close-up of a vintage brass scale tipping unevenly on a wooden table.

beats.say: This week, audit your monthly spending and separate things that pay you from things that drain you.
beats.visual: A hand crossing out lines on a paper ledger with a black marker.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, because...
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single bright lightbulb hanging from the ceiling.

caption: Your home might be costing you more than you think. Learn the rules of real wealth. #MoneyPsychology #PersonalFinance #RealEstateInvesting #WealthBuilding #QuietMoney
description: Robert Kiyosaki's rule flips conventional wisdom on your home. Learn why your house is a liability and how to focus on actual cash-flowing assets.
first_comment: Do you view your primary home as an investment or just a place to live? Let's talk about it below.

facts.claim: In 2012 his company Rich Global LLC filed for bankruptcy after a court ordered it to pay $23.7 million.
facts.basis: Verified research brief fact on Robert Kiyosaki.
